explanation: Possessive words match the possessed noun: mon livre (my book), ma table (my table), mes livres (my books). Stressed pronouns, such as moi and toi (me/you), appear after prepositions or for emphasis. Y often replaces à plus a place; en often replaces de plus something or a quantity.
